en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central European town hall building on a cobblestone square. The main building has three stories, a mansard roof with dormer windows, and a clock tower with a cupola rising from the center of the roof. Decorative reliefs are above the main entrance. To the left runs a narrow street with multi‑story houses, and on the right stands another large, ornate building. A sign on the ground floor of the town hall reads "Ratskeller" and there are a few small figures in early 20th‑century clothing in the square. The caption at the top in red Gothic‑style print reads "Burgstädt. Rathaus."
